setup.lora: r16 alpha32 on the routed experts' gate_up_proj/down_proj; Unsloth: its recommended attention+MLP targets, which include the experts
setup.lora_dropout: 0.05 for Poros; 0 for PEFT, Accelerate and Unsloth (PEFT's ParamWrapper, LoRA on fused 3-D experts, refuses dropout != 0; 0 is also Unsloth's recommended value)
setup.data: synthetic: torch.randint(0, vocab, (20, 512)) seed 0, the same tokens for every arm
setup.script_versions: scripts/table6_bench.py as committed ran the capped arms. poros_streamed and the two poros_resident_spilled runs ran before the cap (lines 19-23) was added; accelerate_offload_gpu20 ran before the ACCEL_GPU_GIB switch, at its default of 20. Peak VRAM is reset after load and covers the training loop; oom_allocated_gib is read after the stack unwinds, so the figure in each OOM's error string is the at-failure one.

host.wsl2_sysmem_fallback: Past the card's memory the Windows driver spills CUDA allocations to host RAM instead of failing. Arms marked capped call torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(free/total) at start (22.76 GiB free), so a run that does not fit OOMs as on a native host; a fraction of exactly 1.0 is not enforced.
